new: Belmont Academy is the Belmont Charter Network’s early-learning school: Head Start, pre-kindergarten and kindergarten. Its page says many children stay after school for art, music, science and sports, and that children usually move on to Belmont Charter School for 1st grade.

The network’s out-of-school-time program runs at Belmont Academy with the school-day staff. Its page lists soccer with Kat Academy, gardening and outdoor classroom time with Greener Partners, arts and crafts, and station activities and open play. Greener Partners’ own page describes after-school garden sessions in Belmont Charter Network schools. Both have listings here; neither posts hours or a price, so ask the school.

Belmont Academy keeps the network’s calendar, not the District’s. Its days off on this page come from the 2026–27 family calendar: it closes for Eid al-Fitr and for staff days on September 21, November 16, February 1 and April 12, and its winter break starts December 21. The days-off planner and the list of who’s open go by the District’s, so check a camp’s dates against Belmont’s.

The calendar marks half days on October 9, November 23 and 24 (report card conferences), February 11 and 12, April 15 and 16, May 28, and June 10 and 11 (the last day). Ask whether after school runs on those afternoons.
If you know a program that serves Belmont Academy and isn’t here, send it in and it goes on this page.
